items.q: How is the AI score calculated?
items.a: We combine FMCSA filings, Experian commercial credit, factoring system telemetry, and anonymous payment cadence reported by 1,240 carriers in the network. The model is retrained weekly and updates broker scores every 6 hours.

items.q: Do I have to switch TMS or change my workflow?
items.a: No. VettGuard is a Chrome extension that lives on DAT, Truckstop, 123Loadboard, and other boards you already use. We connect via OAuth and add a guardrail layer at booking — your dispatcher's flow doesn't change.

items.q: What if a broker disputes a detention claim?
items.a: Our claim packets include GPS arrival/departure pings, eBOL signatures with timestamps, and the rate confirmation's detention terms. 94% are paid without dispute. For the remaining 6%, our ops team handles the back-and-forth — included in the 18% fee.

items.q: How does the 18% success fee actually work?
items.a: When a broker pays detention, the recovered amount is deposited to your bank or factoring account. We deduct 18% automatically at payout — never an invoice. If we don't recover, you owe nothing.

items.q: Is the carrier-reported payment data anonymized?
items.a: Yes. Carriers contribute their broker payment data to the network anonymously. No individual carrier's data is ever exposed to a broker, and brokers have no visibility into who scored them how.

Owner-operators are live in under 60 seconds — install the extension, sign into DAT, done. Mid-size fleets connect their ELD and factoring in another 5 minutes. Enterprise fleets (50+ trucks) get a dedicated implementation manager.
Free plan and Pro are both month-to-month. Cancel anytime, no termination fee. Fleet plans (50+ trucks) are typically annual with quarterly business reviews and custom rates.

items.q: Where is my data stored? Are you SOC 2 compliant?
items.a: Yes — SOC 2 Type II certified. Data is stored encrypted at rest (AES-256) in US-East. We sign DPAs and BAAs on request. Full security overview at vettguard.com/security.
